requirements.description: The user explicitly asks for proximity to parks. Green-service proximity is set at the 75th percentile (74.26, rounded to 74) because the user wants the unit near parks.

The user prefers a property in energy class D or better, so the filter keeps classes A1 through D. Area, capacity, location, and authorization requirements are outside the energy scope and are not filtered here.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 15 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Location (Turin, proximity to parks) and energy class are outside the reference columns and are not filtered here.
